Enforce k-Anonymity (and Optional l-Diversity) on a Research Table

Source: R/anonymity.R
apply_k_anonymity.Rd

Applies safe row suppression ("suppress_rows") or rare-class masking ("mask_rare") to eliminate equivalence classes violating k_min (and optionally l_min distinct values of sensitive_col). Under "mask_rare", if the masked fallback class itself has fewer than k_min rows, additional smallest equivalence classes are progressively generalized into mask_value until the masked class meets k_min (preventing residual sub-k leakage). Returns the privacy-safe data frame together with a before/after risk reduction summary without ever logging raw participant values.

Usage

apply_k_anonymity(
  data,
  quasi_ids,
  k_min = 5L,
  strategy = c("suppress_rows", "mask_rare"),
  mask_value = "[SUPPRESSED]",
  sensitive_col = NULL,
  l_min = 2L,
  include_na = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble.

quasi_ids

Character vector of quasi-identifier column names.

k_min

Integer minimum required equivalence class size (>= 2L, default 5L).

strategy

Character scalar de-identification strategy: "suppress_rows" (default, removes violating rows) or "mask_rare" (replaces quasi-identifiers of violating rows with mask_value).

mask_value

Character scalar replacement value used when strategy = "mask_rare" (default "[SUPPRESSED]").

sensitive_col

Optional character scalar sensitive outcome column for $l$-diversity enforcement.

l_min

Integer minimum required distinct values of sensitive_col per class (>= 2L, default 2L).

include_na

Logical scalar passed to assess_reidentification_risk(). Defaults to TRUE.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_k_anonymized" containing data (privacy-safe tibble), strategy, k_min, l_min, n_rows_before, n_rows_after, n_rows_suppressed, n_rows_masked, risk_before, and risk_after.

Examples

df <- tibble::tibble(
  site = c(rep("North", 6), rep("South", 2), rep("West", 5)),
  wave = c(rep(1L, 6), rep(2L, 2), rep(1L, 5)),
  score = seq_len(13)
)
res <- apply_k_anonymity(df, quasi_ids = c("site", "wave"), k_min = 5L)
res
#> <airgap_k_anonymized> [strategy=suppress_rows, k_min=5]
#>   Rows:            13 -> 11 (suppressed=2, masked=0)
#>   k-anonymity:     FAIL -> PASS (min_k: 2 -> 5)
#>   Prosecutor max:  0.5000 -> 0.2000
